description: Kometrics turns the billing you already run on Stripe, Paddle, Creem or Asaas into subscription metrics you can trust: MRR, ARR, churn, ARPA, LTV, cohorts and the movement ledger underneath them. Ask how MRR moved and it reads the real series month by month; ask why it moved and it opens the individual customer movements behind the number, naming who signed up, expanded or churned. Ask who is at risk and it lists them with the MRR each one carries, and ask about cash and it reports what renewals are due in the next 30, 60 or 90 days. Every figure is computed by the same code that draws the reports in the Kometrics app, and every result carries a link back to the report it came from. The connector is read-only and scoped to a single workspace that the user chooses when they approve the connection.

defaultPrompt: How did my MRR change over the last 6 months, and what caused it?
Which customers are at risk right now?
How much revenue is sitting on customers with failed payments?
